backend/cryptoHolding.mo: Defines the CryptoHolding type with fields for id, symbol, amount, amount invested in GBP, and current value in GBP.
backend/livePortfolioSnapshot.mo: Defines the LivePortfolioSnapshot type with a timestamp and total portfolio value in GBP.
backend/main.mo: Main actor for the crypto portfolio backend, managing per-user holdings, staking rewards, portfolio history, live snapshots, and user profiles with authorization checks via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization.
backend/portfolioHistoryRecord.mo: Defines the PortfolioHistoryRecord type capturing a timestamp, total value in GBP, and total amount invested in GBP.
backend/portfolioMetrics.mo: Defines the PortfolioMetrics type with total value, gain/loss, and percentage change fields in GBP.
backend/stakingReward.mo: Defines the StakingReward type with fields for id, symbol, amount, and reward date.
backend/timeRange.mo: Defines the TimeRange variant type with options for hourly live, day, week, month, six months, year, and all time.
backend/userProfile.mo: Defines the UserProfile type containing a single name field.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a revert of the application from Version 40 back to Version 39 state, listing affected frontend files and components with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short descriptions of each frontend source file, summarizing the purpose and key characteristics of each component, hook, and page.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors for background, foreground, cards, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Crypto Portfolio Tracker app, mounting the React app at the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication state, profile setup flow, and rendering the appropriate view (LoginPrompt, ProfileSetupModal, or Dashboard) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AddHoldingDialog: Dialog form for adding a new crypto holding with an autocomplete symbol dropdown, amount, and amount invested fields, submitting via the useAddHolding mutation.
frontend/src/components/AddStakingReward: Dialog form for recording a new staking reward with symbol, amount, and date inputs, submitting via the useAddStakingReward mutation.
frontend/src/components/EditHoldingDialo: A dialog component for editing an existing cryptocurrency holding, allowing users to update the symbol, amount, and GBP amount invested with form validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/EditStakingRewar: A dialog component for editing an existing staking reward entry, allowing users to update the symbol, amount, and reward date with form validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A simple footer component displaying a copyright notice and a link to caffeine.ai with a pulsing heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky header component providing Internet Identity login/logout, a dark/light theme toggle, and a welcome message showing the authenticated user's profile name.
A card-based manager component that lists all crypto holdings in a table and provides actions to add, edit, increment, delete, and view performance for each holding via child dialogs.
frontend/src/components/IncrementHolding: A dialog component that allows users to add additional tokens and GBP investment to an existing crypto holding, computing and updating the new totals via the update holding mutation.
frontend/src/components/IndividualCrypto: A dialog component that displays performance metrics (gain/loss, current value, total invested) and a simulated line chart for a specific cryptocurrency symbol across selectable time ranges.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Renders a landing page with a login button using Internet Identity authentication and three feature cards highlighting live prices, security, and speed.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioChart.t: Displays a line chart of portfolio value over time using Recharts, generating data points based on the selected time range from holdings and staking rewards.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioComposi: Renders a pie chart showing portfolio allocation by cryptocurrency symbol, calculating values from live prices applied to holdings and staking rewards.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioOvervie: Shows a summary of total portfolio value, cost, and gain/loss metrics alongside per-asset cards sorted by current value, derived from holdings and staking rewards.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioPerform: Renders an area chart of portfolio value over a selected time range using Recharts, with dynamic color based on whether the portfolio is gaining or losing.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Displays a modal card form for new users to enter their name and create a profile, using the saveCallerUserProfile mutation on submission.
frontend/src/components/StakingRewardsMa: React component that displays a table of staking rewards with add, edit, and delete functionality, using dialogs for mutations and toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCryptoPrices.ts: Custom hook that fetches live cryptocurrency prices in GBP from CoinGecko and Revolut X APIs, with symbol-to-ID mappings for a wide range of tokens and response validation utilities.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profile, crypto holdings, staking rewards, and portfolio metrics, wrapping actor calls with caching and mutation invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that configures Tailwind CSS, defines light and dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system, and adds custom keyframe animations for fade-in and pulse-glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page component that renders the portfolio overview and holdings manager sections with a styled heading.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme tokens (colors, border radii, shadows) using OKLCH variables, with typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking version 3 of a fix request to revert the application from Version 40 back to its Version 39 state for both frontend and backend.
